## Episode Thesis

This is a Norwegian personal-finance episode of VG's Pengerådet about which insurance you need at each stage of life, from student to retiree. The hosts' main point is to insure against financial catastrophes, not small losses. In Norway, motor third-party liability is the only legally required cover; home, contents and disability insurance are strongly recommended. There is no equity or market discussion. Insurers like Gjensidige, If and Tryg are named only as examples of consumer providers.
